verdicts.title: High harmonic generation from bulk diamond driven by intense femtosecond laser pulse
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present theoretical results on the high-harmonic generation (HHG) in bulk diamond induced by intense laser pulse of wavelength 800 nm and duration 15 fs. For laser intensity in the range $1 \le I \le 50 $ TW/cm$^2$ above bandgap harmonics are generated after the pulse peak.
